title: FNAF Jumpscare Scream
blurb: The Five Nights at Freddy's jumpscare scream — the shriek that launched a thousand reaction videos and, arguably, an entire genre of horror YouTube. Its power is structural rather than sonic: the game buries you in near-silence, forcing you to listen intently for footsteps, then detonates this at full volume the instant you make a mistake. You are maximally attentive at exactly the wrong moment. A decade later it still triggers fight-or-flight in anyone who played it at a formative age. Volume warning genuinely intended.
origin: The animatronic jumpscare scream from Five Nights at Freddy's (2014).
